remarks: Welcome to 686 Mount Vernon; a beautifully maintained brick Cape with tremendous versatility and updates throughout. This four bedroom home offers a surprisingly spacious floor plan with beautiful original hardwood floors, neutral color scheme and plenty of natural light. As you enter through the charming front entry, a bright and spacious living room features oak hardwood floors and large picture window overlooking the front yard. Newly remodeled kitchen features white shaker cabinetry, beautiful counters, tile backsplash, newer flooring and all of appliances. Two sizable first floor bedrooms both offer beautiful hardwood floors, ample closet space and versatility. Full bath maintains loads of original charm with vintage tile, pedestal sink and classic black and white mosaic flooring. Heading upstairs, you'll be delighted by the amount of additional living space! Two spacious bedrooms with newer plush carpeting, fresh neutral paint and an abundance of storage offer endless possibilities including the opportunity to create a spectacular primary suite. Enjoy three seasons of Buffalo weather from the bright and airy enclosed rear patio overlooking the fully fenced yard. Outside, a wide concrete driveway offers plenty of off-street parking and leads to a two car detached garage. Beautifully maintained yard with mature landscaping, perennial gardens and plenty of green space offers a private setting to relax, entertain and enjoy the outdoors. Clean and dry full basement provides an abundance of additional storage along with dedicated laundry and workshop areas. Central air keeps you comfortable throughout the summer months. New windows throughout along with newer furnace, AC and solid roof offer many years of care-free living. Conveniently located just minutes from shopping, restaurants, schools and thruway access, 686 Mount Vernon combines classic Cape Cod character, a flexible floor plan and incredible value in a home that is truly move-in ready in Cleveland Hill School District. Square Footage measured by Licensed Appraiser. Open House on Saturday, October 10 from 11AM-1PM.
